description: Graph .NET is a Microsoft Graph client library for .NET. It gives you strongly typed access to Microsoft 365 services — read, send, reply to and forward mail, manage mail folders, message rules and change notifications, work with calendars, events, recurring appointments, reminders and free/busy schedules, manage users, groups, contacts and Outlook categories, upload, download and share files on OneDrive, work with SharePoint sites, lists and list items, manage To Do and Planner tasks, read Excel workbooks, and access Teams, channels, chats, online meetings, calls and recordings. Messages can be downloaded as .eml or .msg files. Supports OAuth 2.0 authentication using username and password, client secret, device code or authorization code. The library does not require any other third party application or library to work.
